mods.name: desktop-notify
mods.description: Shows a desktop notification when Claude Code needs your input: osascript on macOS, notify-send elsewhere when it is installed. The text is the project name and a short status only.

mods.name: slack-notify
mods.description: Posts to a Slack incoming webhook when Claude Code needs your input. Sends the project name and a short status only. Does nothing until you set a webhook URL.

mods.name: discord-notify
mods.description: Posts to a Discord webhook when Claude Code needs your input. Sends the project name and a short status only. Does nothing until you set a webhook URL.

mods.name: say-done
mods.description: On macOS, says "Claude is done" when a turn ends after more than 30 seconds. Does nothing on other platforms.

mods.name: auto-lint
mods.description: Runs your project's own linter fix (eslint, ruff or golangci-lint) on each file Claude writes or edits, only when the project has that linter's config, and tells Claude what is left.

mods.name: notify-pack
mods.description: Local alerts in one: a desktop notification when Claude Code needs your input, and a spoken line on macOS when a long turn ends.
